name: Itching Poison
details:
Mode of Transmission: Touch

This poison consists of a green powder that causes inflammation and extreme
itching in the affected area. It is usually placed on the clothes the person will wear.

Effect: After being affected, the victim becomes weakened (-1) for any agility and
related skill tests (Acrobatics, Escape, and Stealth) for 1 hour or until treated.

name: Laxative Poison
details:
Mode of transmission: Ingestion

This is a substance considerably feared by those who know it, not for its deadly
capabilities, but rather for the "social damage" it causes.
cause in the victim.

Effects: The victim will experience severe stomach pains followed by an almost
uncontrollable "attack" of gas. They will suffer from intense diarrhea, which cannot
be contained for more than two minutes, no matter where the victim is. The diarrhea
will last for two days, unless...
(Medicine test), in this state the victim receives a -1 penalty to accuracy for social
tests.

name: Stinging Venom
details:
Mode of Transmission: Touch

This poison consists of a paste made by macerating certain specific leaves. Upon
contact with the body, the paste causes severe skin irritation, potentially leading to
redness and swelling throughout the body. Typically, this paste is applied to the
inside of the victim's clothing, who then performs a resistance test upon wearing it.

Effects: Your skin will become very red with swelling all over your body, even your face. In
this case, you will receive a -1 penalty to accuracy on all social tests. The effects last for 8
hours or until treated.

name: Nasal Inflammation Venom
details:
Prerequisite: Dokujutsu 1
Mode of Transmission: Inhalation

This poison consists of a white powder with a high capacity to inflame the nasal
passages. It can easily mix with air and congests the nasal passages and trachea
of those affected, causing them to cough and have a stuffy nose.
Effects: If the victim fails the test, their airways will become inflamed and they will
suffer a -1 penalty to accuracy on choking tests for 1 hour or more.
to be treated.

name: Sleeping Body
details:
Mode of Transmission: Ingestion

This is a mild sleeping powder that is highly soluble in water and, therefore, is usually used
mixed in wine or other beverages.

Effects: If you fail the resistance test, you will become unconscious.

hours. The victim is awakened by any sudden movement or loud noise. For an ally

If the victim achieves all 3 successes before falling asleep, they will not fall asleep.

name: Minor Weakening Poison
transmission: Ingestion or Bloodstream (Choose one when producing)
details:
Mode of Transmission: Ingestion or Bloodstream (Choose one when producing)

A poison created to sap the strength of those affected, causing the production of lactic
acid in the muscles and preventing the person from exerting their full strength.

Effects: If the victim fails the resistance test, they will feel muscle pain when exerting
force and will suffer Weakened Strength (-1), in addition to losing -2 Strength in
Damage calculations for 2 hours.

name: Sleeping Gel
transmission: Ingestion or Bloodstream (Choose one when producing)
details:
Mode of Transmission: Ingestion or Bloodstream (Choose one when producing)
This substance is a clear liquid that, when ingested, causes extreme drowsiness in
the victim. It is usually mixed with wine or other strong drinks to mask its smell.

Effects: If the resistance test fails, the person will become drowsy and have difficulty
perceiving their surroundings, becoming weakened (-1) for LM, Perception, and
related skill tests.

Furthermore, the victim will become unconscious if they fail 5 resistance tests against
the poison before achieving the 3 successes needed to mitigate its effects. The sleep
will last for a maximum of 2 hours. The victim is awakened by any sudden movement
or loud noise. For an ally to awaken the victim from sleep during combat is a standard
action. For an enemy to awaken, they only need to inflict any damage.

If the victim achieves all 3 successes before falling asleep, they will only fall asleep 1
hour after the scene ends.

name: Minor Debilitating Poison
transmission:
Ingestion, Inhalation, Touch, or Bloodstream
(Choose one when producing)
details:
Mode of Transmission: Ingestion, Inhalation, Touch, or Bloodstream
(Choose one when producing)

Also called "cheap poison," this poison is completely artificial, not depending on any
natural or rare substances for its production. Its effectiveness is low, but this is often
offset by its relatively low cost per dose.
Effects: If the victim fails the resistance test, they will feel very strong pain and will
be weakened (-1) for any test they perform, except resistance tests, for 4 hours.

name: Intoxication Poison
transmission: Ingestion or Inhalation (Choose one when producing)
details:
Mode of Transmission: Ingestion or Inhalation (Choose one when producing)

Also known as a "tongue-opener," it is a small effervescent sphere that, when
placed in a drink, dissolves in a few seconds. It has an alcoholic and calming effect
that disinhibits the person and makes it much easier to extract information peacefully.

Effect: If social rules are being used, the victim receives a -2 penalty on their rolls
to resist social tests if they fail the resistance test.
If you are not following social rules, the effects are open to interpretation.

name: Minor Eye Venom
details:
Mode of Transmission: Touch

A poison created to cause dryness and swelling of the eyeballs, making it more
difficult to see.

Effects: If the victim fails the resistance test, they will feel burning in their eyes and
difficulty keeping them open due to swelling of the eyelids, becoming dazed and
Weakened (-2) in Perception (and associated skills) if they need to use their vision
for 2 hours.

name: Dizziness Poison
details:
Prerequisite: Dokujutsu 3
Mode of Transmission: Bloodstream

A poison designed to cause a severe migraine with stabbing pains that makes it
difficult to think clearly and focus.

Effect: If the victim fails the resistance test, they will have difficulty concentrating.
They will suffer from Impaired Intelligence (-1) and Impaired Concentration (-1) for
4 hours.

name: Minor Hallucinogenic Poison
transmission: Ingestion, Inhalation, or Bloodstream (Choose one when
details:
Mode of Transmission: Ingestion, Inhalation, or Bloodstream (Choose one when
producing)

A mixture of hallucinogenic mushrooms that, when absorbed by the human body,
cause auditory and visual hallucinations.
Effects: If the victim fails the resistance test, they will begin to suffer from strong hallucinations
and lose control of their actions, becoming confused until they pass all 3 resistance tests.

name: Weakening Poison
transmission: Ingestion or Bloodstream (Choose one when producing)
details:
Mode of Transmission: Ingestion or Bloodstream (Choose one when producing)

A poison created from calming leaves that hinder the tensioning of peripheral muscle tissue,
further diminishing the target's strength.

Effect: If the victim fails the resistance test, they will feel muscle pain when exerting force

and will suffer Weakened Strength (-2), in addition to losing -4 Strength in damage
calculations for 4 hours.

name: Lethargic Poison
transmission: Touch or Bloodstream (Choose one when producing)
details:
Mode of Transmission: Touch or Bloodstream (Choose one when producing)

This is venom extracted from snakes or scorpions, produced in such a way as to become
viscous enough not to detach from weapons during use.
a fight.

Effects: If the victim fails the resistance test, they will feel very strong pain, accompanied by

malaise and fatigue, remaining exhausted for 4 hours.

name: Interrogation Poison
transmission: Ingestion or Inhalation (Choose one when producing)
details:
Mode of Transmission: Ingestion or Inhalation (Choose one when producing)

This poison consists of a few drops that can be mixed with food or drink. It acts on the
victim's brain to remove their sense of danger and inhibition.

Effect: If the victim fails the saving throw, they suffer a -3 penalty on their social saving

throws. If the rules are not being followed, the effect will be interpreted by the narrator. Thugs
and trivial NPCs always fail this saving throw, and when affected, they always fail social rolls.

name: Paralyzing Poison
details:
Mode of Transmission: Bloodstream

This venom is similar to the Minor Paralytic, but with more extensive processing and
refinement of the natural venom extracted from scorpions, to increase its potency.

Effects: If the victim fails the resistance test, they will feel pain.
very strong, accompanied by malaise and tiredness, feeling dizzy for 4
hours.

name: Superior Sleeping Gun
details:
Transmission Method: Ingestion, Inhalation, or Bloodstream (Choose when
producing)

This sleeping pill is a colorless liquid with a very strong odor that evaporates upon
contact with air, capable of rendering a person unconscious in seconds.
Effects: If the resistance test fails, the person will become drowsy and have difficulty
perceiving their surroundings, becoming weakened (-2) for LM, Perception, and
related skill tests.

Furthermore, the victim will become unconscious if they fail 4 poison resistance tests
before achieving the 3 successes needed to mitigate the poison's negative effects.
The sleep lasts for a maximum of two hours. The sleep is deep, and the victim does
not easily awaken with sudden movements or loud noises. For an ally, waking the
victim from deep sleep during combat is a full action. For an enemy to awaken, they
only need to inflict any damage.

If the victim achieves all 3 successes before falling asleep, they will only fall asleep at the
end of the scene.

name: Hallucinogenic Poison
transmission: Ingestion, Inhalation, or Bloodstream (Choose one when
details:
Mode of Transmission: Ingestion, Inhalation, or Bloodstream (Choose one when
producing)

A blend of carefully crafted and refined hallucinogenic mushrooms that, when
absorbed by the human body, cause strong hallucinations.
sound and visual.

Effects: If the victim fails the resistance test, they will begin to suffer from strong
hallucinations and lose control of their actions, suffering from impaired Intelligence
and Perception (-2) (and related skills) for 8 hours and confusion until they pass all 3
resistance tests.

name: Debilitating Poison
transmission:
Ingestion, Inhalation, Touch, or Bloodstream
(Choose one when producing)
details:
Mode of Transmission: Ingestion, Inhalation, Touch, or Bloodstream
(Choose one when producing)

A stronger and more elaborate version of the lesser debilitating poison, in which the chemist
adds even more toxic substances to enhance the effects.

Effects: If the victim fails the test, they will feel very strong pain and will be weakened
(-2) for any test they perform, except resistance tests, for 8 hours.

name: Eye Venom
details:
Prerequisite: Dokujutsu 6
Mode of Transmission: Touch

This poison consists of a paste that emits a gas that penetrates the victim's eyes and
blackens their vision.

Effects: If the victim fails the resistance test, part of their vision will be obscured,
resulting in a 50% chance of failure on attacks and Impaired Perception (-4) (and
associated skills) when needing to use sight for 4 hours.

name: Superior Debilitating Venom
transmission:
Ingestion, Inhalation, Touch, or Bloodstream
(Choose one when producing)
details:
Mode of Transmission: Ingestion, Inhalation, Touch, or Bloodstream
(Choose one when producing)

The ultimate version of a debilitating poison, mixing and concentrating some of the
most toxic substances in existence, capable of taking down even the greatest warriors
and versatile in combat.

Effects: If the victim fails the test, they will feel intense pain and weakness throughout
their body, becoming exhausted until treated.

name: Superior Weakening Poison
transmission: Ingestion or Bloodstream (Choose one when producing)
details:
Mode of Transmission: Ingestion or Bloodstream (Choose one when producing)

A poison created from concentrated calming leaves that hinder the tensioning of
peripheral muscle tissue, further diminishing the target's strength.

Effects: If the victim fails the resistance test, they will feel muscle pain when exerting
force and will suffer Weakened Strength (-3), Vigor
Weakened (-2) (but not for endurance tests), in addition to losing -
6 Strength in damage calculations until it is dealt with.

name: Superior Eye Venom
details:
Mode of Transmission: Touch

A paste with a high dissolving capacity that causes the cornea to melt, resulting
in vision loss until treatment is received.

Effects: If the victim fails the test, they will feel unbearable pain in their eyes, and
their involuntary reflexes will force them to keep them closed, leaving them blind
until treated.

name: Red Death
details:
Prerequisite: Dokujutsu 10
Mode of Transmission: Bloodstream
The Red Death is one of the worst torments a man can endure. It is a true alchemy
using the venoms of the most poisonous animals in existence, creating a liquid of
a very dark red, almost black. The liquid is viscous enough to be used on the tips
of projectiles and cutting or piercing weapons.

Once inside the victim's body, the venom begins to spread rapidly, causing an
unprecedented rejection effect. The veins through which it passes bulge visibly,
becoming like red roots on the skin, in an agonizing process. In the most severe
cases, the body tries to expel the blood in any way possible, causing veins and
arteries to rupture inexplicably in a process that can last minutes depending on
the victim's resistance.

Another point is that the minds of the victims are equally affected, and it is very
common for survivors of the Red Death to become insane or bloodthirsty.

Effects: If the victim fails the test, their blood will boil and the effects described
previously will occur. From then on, they will be weakened (-
3) for all tests for one hour.

Whenever you repeat the resistance test and fail, you lose 15 points of Vitality. If
you fail three times (consecutively or not), you become paralyzed, falling to the
ground. On the following turn, you will be unconscious, and your Vitality will be
reduced to 0. If left untreated within three days, the character will die. Crafting an
antidote for the Red Death is so...
It's difficult to believe that there is no cure for this poison (This doesn't prevent
some skilled doctor from creating an antidote or treatment).

name: Red Scorpion Venom
details:
Prerequisite: Dokujutsu 10
Mode of Transmission: Touch or Bloodstream

This is the most practical version of the most dangerous natural poison in
existence: the venom of a red scorpion. Red scorpions are creatures of great
beauty, as their bodies gleam like pure gold, but their sting is extremely dangerous.
Rare and coveted, these scorpions can only be found in the largest deserts,
hidden beneath the highest sand dunes, a fact that further fuels the myth.

about these creatures.

The venom of the red scorpion evaporates very quickly once it comes into contact
with air, making it very difficult to handle. However, if processed in a way that
prevents it from evaporating or detaching from weapons during combat, it can be
sold for exorbitant prices to the right people.

Effects: If the victim fails the test, they will be paralyzed due to pain during the
first turn the poison takes effect, losing 10 points of
Vitality per turn and becoming weakened (-3) for all tests.
during one day.
If the character fails the resistance test three times (consecutively or not), they
will become paralyzed and fall to the ground. On the following turn, they will
become unconscious and their Vitality will be reduced to 0. If left untreated within
three days, the character will die.

name: Black Salamander Venom
details:
Prerequisite: Dokujutsu 10
Mode of Transmission: Inhalation, Touch, or Bloodstream

The black salamander is a rare creature native to Amegakure, famous for the
deadly venom its body produces. The strength of its venom is comparable only to
that of the red scorpion.

They say that, once, they implanted the venom sac of a black salamander into a
child's body, and as a result, the child gained the ability to produce the same
venom, as well as developing a resistance to it. Even breathing near it...

This child was dangerous because his breath released toxins. Rumors say this child became
the legendary shinobi Hanzo the Salamander.

Effect: If the victim fails the test, they will be paralyzed due to pain during the first
turn the poison takes effect, losing 5 Vitality points per turn and becoming
weakened (-3) for all tests for one day.

If she fails the resistance test three times (consecutively or not), she will be
paralyzed and fall to the ground. On her next turn, she will become unconscious.
